senses.gloss: m. (נְבֵל) = h. נוֹבֶלֶת, an inferior variety of figs.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 8:13">Targ. Jer. VIII, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 34:4">Targ. Is. XXXIV, 4</cite>.—Pl. <he>נִבְלֵי</he>, <cite ref="M01772"><he>נִי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:9">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>הלואי צדיקים דהא אינם אלא צדיקים נ׳</he> I wished, they were righteous, but they are only righteous men of an inferior quality (cmp. <cite ref="Q00041"><he>פּגָּה</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 83">Yalk. ib. 83</cite> (some ed. <he>נִיכְלֵי</he>).
